prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A striking, hyper-realistic scene of a man partially submerged in a pool of deep blue liquid, captured at the precise moment a dramatic splash erupts around his body. The subject is positioned horizontally, his head tilted back and eyes closed in a state of serene surrender, while his right arm extends outward, fingers relaxed. The blue liquid forms dynamic, sculptural waves and droplets, frozen in mid-air, enveloping his torso and arm with a sense of motion and fluidity. The lighting is soft yet directional, highlighting the contours of his face and the glossy, translucent textures of the liquid. The color palette is dominated by rich, saturated blues contrasted against the natural skin tones of the man and a neutral, out-of-focus background. The composition is cinematic, with a shallow depth of field that draws attention to the subject and the intricate details of the splash, evoking a sense of suspended time and immersive, almost surreal beauty. The overall style is reminiscent of high-speed photography or a slow-motion film still, emphasizing both the power and tranquility of the moment.
